summary: The change maps CL_HTTP_UTILITY=>IF_HTTP_UTILITY~DECODE_BASE64 to a new abap.DecodeBase64 native, which reuses the existing Node-compatible DecodeXBase64 and passes the bytes to a new nodeutf8.Decode. nodeutf8.Decode implements the WHATWG/V8 maximal-subpart UTF-8 decoder. A differential fuzz of 200k random byte strings and 100k mixed Base64 strings (standard/URL-safe alphabets, padding, junk characters) against Node's Buffer gave 0 mismatches. The Go tests, the new emit-go test and the listed acceptance/regression tests all pass.

findings.claim: The expected value for the 'two bytes' case is an invisible literal U+0080 (bytes C2 80), so it reads as an empty string in the source; "\u0080" would make the intent clear.

The test creates its scratch Go package inside the tracked tree (go/cmd/gogen-b64-test-*). The finally block removes it, but a killed or timed-out run leaves a stray package that later `go test ./...` runs will pick up.
